honey_adulteration.kristy_take: Raw, unfiltered honey with honey the only ingredient. Use it because you like it; it is still sugar, just a real, old one.
honey_adulteration.detail: Raw honey has not been heated, so it keeps its enzymes, and unfiltered honey keeps more of what came from the hive. Heating does not spoil honey as a food, but the enzymes may be compromised. Commercial honey is often blended, and some has corn syrup added. A jar that names its producer and says “raw” or “unfiltered” is the reliable route. Crystallizing is what raw honey does over time. Being an old, traditional food is a fair reason to prefer real honey. Tradition speaks to it being a real food, and it is still sugar.
